{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-la-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"39da01b29e31b4465b1ae70e62931c4588e639b3e52ab6f85fb06485f9471f68","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-la-class-std:lineage:19","source_registry_sha256":"8fb2294cb50570a3a0fabb25acba3418dba999eb7dd305cc58b73fdf38975613","source_liveness_sha256":"1105a92b5841d065519de4b7fbea05111880de6d2bb8804066a972d19c63b5a0"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Flag persons, signals, markings and roundabouts","heading":"Flag persons, signals, markings and roundabouts","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"# Flag persons, signals, markings and roundabouts

FACT_ID: sec05-F01 | anchor: A01
Work-zone flaggers direct vehicles to stop, slow or travel through the work area. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F02 | anchor: A01
Flaggers use red flags or stop-and-slow paddles and wear orange outer clothing. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F03 | anchor: A01
On a vertical traffic signal, red is above yellow and green is below yellow. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F04 | anchor: A01
On a horizontal signal, red is at the left, yellow at the center and green at the right. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F05 | anchor: A01
A steady green permits proceeding only when the intersection is clear. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F06 | anchor: A01
A driver starting on green must first let traffic already crossing clear the intersection. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F07 | anchor: A01
Turning left on a steady green requires yielding to approaching traffic and pedestrians. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F08 | anchor: A01
A green arrow allows travel in its indicated direction when the intersection is clear of other road users. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F09 | anchor: A01
Even with a green arrow, watch for drivers turning right on red from the opposite side. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F10 | anchor: A01
Drivers turning at an intersection must watch for pedestrians approaching from ahead or either side. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F11 | anchor: A01
A steady yellow warns that red is coming; slow and stop completely if that can be done before the stop bar. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F12 | anchor: A01
If yellow begins after the vehicle is already in the intersection, the driver may finish crossing safely. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F13 | anchor: A01
A flashing yellow calls for slowing, checking entering traffic and continuing cautiously. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F14 | anchor: A01
At a flashing yellow, stop for traffic already in the intersection and let it pass before continuing. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F15 | anchor: A01
A steady yellow arrow warns that the green-arrow phase is ending; prepare to stop and yield to opposing traffic or pedestrians. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-F16 | anchor: A02
A steady red requires stopping before the stop bar, crosswalk or intersection and waiting for green, except for permitted turns. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-F17 | anchor: A02
A right turn on red is permitted after a stop and yielding to traffic and pedestrians unless a sign forbids it. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-F18 | anchor: A02
The guide permits some left turns on red from one one-way street to another one-way street. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-F19 | anchor: A02
Where a left turn on red is permitted, yield to crossing traffic and pedestrians ahead and beside the vehicle. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-F20 | anchor: A02
Treat a flashing red as a stop sign: stop fully, check both directions and yield before entering. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-F21 | anchor: A02
A red arrow prohibits proceeding in its direction until the arrow becomes green. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-F22 | anchor: A02
Yellow center markings divide traffic traveling in opposing directions. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-F23 | anchor: A02
Stay right of a single broken yellow centerline; cross it to pass or turn only when safe. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-F24 | anchor: A02
Double solid yellow centerlines prohibit crossing for a pass, but the guide allows crossing them for a turn. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-F25 | anchor: A02
A solid yellow no-passing marking on a two-lane road bars passing from that side. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-F26 | anchor: A02
The guide allows crossing its no-passing line for a turn or when a dashed line is on the driver’s side. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]
